why: The fitted models live in output/*.rds, which is gitignored because it is a rebuildable cache. The rendered report is the only tracked carrier of these numbers, so they are transcribed here to be chartable. Re-render the report and they can be checked line by line.
task: Binary classification: is a fragrance rated at or above the median?

models.name: Naive Bayes
models.rejected_because: sensitivity collapses to 0.20; it buys specificity by almost never predicting the positive class

clusters.method: K-means, not retained as a classifier, kept as a descriptive read

caveat: Every AUC sits near 0.65 to 0.69. The models separate the classes, but only modestly: fragrance ratings are not well predicted by accords and notes alone.
